source_disposition.outcome: Discharged after two days; full neurological recovery at follow-up.

distractors: Source describes a stroke mimic, but axial pain and bilateral sphincter/leg deficits localize to spinal cord.
critical_safety_points: Treat evolving paraplegia and sphincter dysfunction as spinal emergency.
